hyperedges.label: Bricks write pipeline (spec -> flat array -> guarded save)

nodes.label: MCP-Protocol-Version header fix
nodes.rationale: Test MCP connection must send MCP-Protocol-Version header after initialize.

nodes.label: Bricks saving flow
nodes.rationale: Never bypass update_post_metadata guard; security check, revision, CSS regen, read-back.

nodes.label: Core ability hooks (wp_ability_permission_result, wp_pre_execute_ability, wp_after_execute_ability)
nodes.rationale: Arrived in WP 7.1, hence minimum WP 7.1.

nodes.label: Custom-code group (off by default)
nodes.rationale: Requires manage_options and unfiltered_html; Bricks code saved unsigned, no API signing.

nodes.label: Dry run (dryRun diff)
nodes.rationale: Only possible for own tools; official abilities have fixed schemas.

nodes.label: Per-user rate limit
nodes.rationale: Sliding minute window, best-effort; 120 reads/30 writes per minute.

nodes.label: Read-only mode
nodes.rationale: Denies abilities whose annotations.readonly !== true; unknown treated as write.

nodes.label: Snapshots + restore (mcpb_snapshots table)
nodes.rationale: Restore snapshots current state first so a restore can be undone.

nodes.label: Target resolvers
nodes.rationale: Map ability name to snapshot target; unknown writes get audit only (fail safe).

nodes.label: MCP Builder plugin
nodes.rationale: Free open-source WordPress plugin letting AI clients build Bricks/Elementor pages via MCP using native elements and settings.

nodes.label: /wp-json/mcp-builder/mcp endpoint
nodes.rationale: No separate server to run; single connection for all clients.

nodes.label: Build own toolset, not depend on official abilities
nodes.norm_label: build own toolset, not depend on official abilities
nodes.rationale: Owner decision 2026-10-12: official Elementor MCP only supports v4 Atomic; Bricks 2.4 abilities experimental. Own toolset + governance of all abilities.

nodes.label: Governance layer over all managed abilities
nodes.norm_label: governance layer over all managed abilities
nodes.rationale: Core ability hooks let the plugin govern abilities it does not own (mcp-builder/, bricks/, elementor/ namespaces).

nodes.label: No OAuth in v1
nodes.rationale: No WordPress-side OAuth server exists; Application Passwords cover all clients.

nodes.label: Prompt-injection mitigations
nodes.rationale: Site content only in structured fields, flagged untrusted, truncated; writes audited and snapshotted so hijacks are visible and reversible.

nodes.label: Errors with 'How to fix' messages
nodes.rationale: Adapter bug #298 drops error data, so message must carry the fix.
